body: Delivery decision needed: cand-7KHF/d2 was landable, but proposal op 20260901T124429 for unrelated cand-6D9 made its evidence stale via the known same-base pair defect; its old authorization is also granted only to claude actors. Fast coherent remedy: let this current-main combined successor carry the exact already-approved d2 two-file probe patch, then the b33 support patch plus the three reviewed cost/signed-zero blobs. That yields one green 30-path commit and avoids a guaranteed stale/conflict cycle. I will not claim or close the probe bead, land, or carry reviews. Approve this exact composition, or direct me to wait for a d2 recut.
